verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a plugin platform, but nothing in the evidence shows the core Codex Plugins runtime or directory can be run on your own infrastructure. Plugins install into OpenAI-operated ChatGPT/Codex surfaces through one universal plugin directory and an OpenAI submission and review process. Local or repo marketplaces and developer-run MCP servers are authoring and distribution features, not self-hosting of the core product.
